messages:
Kai (Partnerships): Quick thread  OrbitWorks sent final assets for the marketplace tile + SI data sheet. They have strict brand rules (no lockup rotation) and want to include a customer quote that mentions a competitor by name. Need legal check on redaction + design on lockup constraints.
Nadia (Partner Ops): Files: https://drive.redwood/partners/orbitworks/assets_v2. Contains orbit_logo.svg, orbit_lockup_rules.pdf, orbit_case_partner.pdf, orbit_thumbnail.psd
Rachel (Design): Lockup rules: no rotation, min clearspace 28px, do not overlay photography. The PSD uses a shadow under the logo I already disabled. Also they want the logo to sit left of Redwood lockup with 40px gap, not our usual 32px. We should respect partner rules unless they conflict with marketplace sizing.
Oren (PMM): The customer quote calls out CloudAlpha by name in a negative context. Using that quote could trigger defamation risk. Vera, need legal to confirm if we can publish as-is or if we should redact competitor mention.
Vera (Legal): Redaction recommended. Publishing a negative mention of a third party could lead to claims. Ask OrbitWorks if they can provide an edited quote or alternative. If they insist, we need OrbiteWorks to indemnify or confirm they own the quote and accept responsibility.
Nadia (Partner Ops): I messaged OrbitWorks asking for a redacted version or permission language. Waiting on reply.
Rachel (Design): Also the partner insists on the left spacing change; I'll add a note in the README explaining deviation from our default spacing and include the partner's lockup_rules.pdf so our marketplace ops team understands.
UploadBot: Files uploaded: orbit_lockup_rules.pdf, orbit_logo.svg, orbit_case_partner.pdf
Oren (PMM): For the marketplace tagline, propose: "OrbitWorks + Redwood: private inference at scale." Avoid any negative competitor mention.
Kai (Partnerships): Agreed. If OrbitWorks returns a redacted quote, proceed. Otherwise, we keep the quote out and use a neutral customer paraphrase like "customer reports improved throughput" without naming competitor.
Vera (Legal): Also confirm the case release scope and that OrbitWorks has rights to publish the quote. If they own the quote and accept responsibility for content, we can proceed with indemnity.
Nadia (Partner Ops): OrbitWorks just replied: they can provide a redacted quote and sent `orbit_case_partner_redacted.pdf` with competitor name removed. They also accepted a standard indemnity clause in the partner contract.
Vera (Legal): Received redacted PDF. Legal OK. Add line to README: "Competitor references redacted by OrbitWorks on 2026-08-03; partner agreed to indemnity."
Rachel (Design): I'll export `orbit_badge_light.png` and `orbit_badge_dark.png` and include the partner's spacing requirement in README. Also adding `orbit_alt_text_en.md`.
Nadia (Partner Ops): Publishing checklist: 1) redacted quote in folder (done) 2) design exports (Rachel) 3) README updated with legal clause (Vera) 4) copy approved (Oren) 5) file naming per convention (Nadia).
Oren (PMM): Approving final copy: `OrbitWorks + Redwood: private inference at scale.` Uploaded as `partner-orbitworks-copy_v1.txt`.
UploadBot: Reminder scheduled: publish-ready-review in 24h for partners/orbitworks/thread/2078901123
Kai (Partnerships): Great work. Let's keep an internal note that OrbitWorks requires a custom 40px lockup gap in the asset metadata.
